text:
Captain America: Civil War | Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast
This week's rewatch pits Team Captain America against Team Iron Man, and Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez are picking sides as they revisit the debate that captivated the MCU fandom in the aftermath of Marvel Studios' Captain America: Civil War. As part of their rewatch of The Infinity Saga, they track the aftermath of the Sokovia Accords, Bucky Barnes' return as a fugitive, and the airport battle that changed everything, plus the arrivals of Black Panther and Spider-Man in the MCU.
